records.name: Honoring a Hero
records.objectives_text: Travel to Uther's Tomb in Western Plaguelands and use Uther's Tribute at his statue, and then return to Wagner Hammerstrike outside Ironforge before the Harvest Festival is over.

objectives.text: Place a tribute at Uther's Tomb

records.name: Honoring a Hero
records.objectives_text: Travel to Grom's Monument in the Demon Fall Canyon of Ashenvale and use Grom's Tribute at the base of the monument. Return to Javnir Nashak outside Orgrimmar before the Harvest Festival is over.

records.name: Test Kill Quest
records.objectives_text: Kill 5 Murlocs and come back to the test character.

records.name: Deadly Desert Venom
records.objectives_text: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 8 Stonelash Scorpid Stingers and 8 Sand Skitterer Fangs. Return to her when you have completed the task.

records.name: Noggle's Last Hope
records.objectives_text: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 3 Stonelash Pincer Stingers, 3 Stonelash Flayer Stingers and 3 Rock Stalker Fangs.

records.name: The Twilight Lexicon
records.objectives_text: Bring the three chapters of the Twilight Lexicon to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.

records.name: Securing the Supply Lines
records.objectives_text: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to kill 15 Dredge Strikers.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Hero's Call: Silithus! / Warchief's Command: Silithus! or The Dunes of Silithus / The Sands of Silithus

records.name: Stepping Up Security
records.objectives_text: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to slay 20 Dredge Crushers.

records.name: Noggle's Lost Satchel
records.objectives_text: Retrieve Noggle's Satchel from the mountains in the south of Silithus and return it to him at Cenarion Hold.

records.name: Wanted - Deathclasp, Terror of the Sands
records.objectives_text: Bring Deathclasp's Pincer to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard.

wiki.page: Wanted - Deathclasp, Terror of the Sands

records.name: The Twilight Mystery
records.objectives_text: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to collect 8 Twilight Tablet Fragments.

records.name: The Deserter
records.objectives_text: Take the restored tablet to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.

records.name: A Terrible Purpose
records.objectives_text: Take the Decoded Tablet Parchment to Commander Mar'alith.

records.name: Dearest Natalia
records.objectives_text: Question Frankal and Rutgar at Bronzebeard's Encampment about the whereabouts of Natalia Mar'alith.

records.name: Into The Maw of Madness
records.objectives_text: Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to find his beloved Natalia. The information that you gathered points to Hive'Regal in the south as being the area in which you may find Mistress Natalia Mar'alith. Do not forget to visit the dwarves at Bronzebeard's camp before venturing into the hive. They might have some additional work and advice for you. And , remember the Commander's

objectives.text: The Fate of Mistress Natalia Mar'alith

records.name: Desert Recipe
records.objectives_text: Look for information about cooking :Sandworm Meat at the Twilight's Hammer camp west of Cenarion Hold.

records.name: Brann Bronzebeard's Lost Letter
records.objectives_text: Take Brann Bronzebeard's Letter to Bronzebeard's Encampment in southern Silithus.

records.name: Glyph Chasing
records.objectives_text: Use the Geologist's Transcription Kit to make a Hive'Regal Rubbing from the Hive'Regal Glyphed Crystal.

records.name: Breaking the Code
records.objectives_text: Obtain an intact Hive'Regal Silithid Brain from any silithid in Hive'Regal.

records.name: Hallow's End Treats for Jesper!
records.objectives_text: Speak with the innkeepers of Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, as well as Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge. Perform the tricks they ask of you in exchange for the treats they offer. Return to Jesper in front of Stormwind with a Darnassus Marzipan, Gnomeregan Gumdrop, Stormwind Nougat, and Ironforge Mint.

records.name: Hallow's End Treats for Spoops!
records.objectives_text: Speak with the innkeepers of Orgrimmar, Undercity, and Thunder Bluff, as well as Kali Remik Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits. Perform the tricks they ask of you in exchange for the treats they offer. Return to Spoops at the Orgrimmar Orphanage with a Thunder Bluff Marzipan, Darkspear Gumdrop, Orgrimmar Nougat, and Undercity Mint.

records.name: Sharing the Knowledge
records.objectives_text: Bring the Torn Recipe Page to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold.

records.name: Unraveling the Mystery
records.objectives_text: Deliver the Glyphed Crystal Prism to Geologist Larksbane at the Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

records.name: Kitchen Assistance
records.objectives_text: Calandrath at Cenarion Hold needs a batch of 10 Smoked Desert Dumplings.

records.name: Secret Communication
records.objectives_text: Bring 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

records.name: Twilight Geolords
records.objectives_text: Kill 10 Twilight Geolords, then return to Huum Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

records.name: Vyral the Vile
records.objectives_text: Slay Vyral the Vile and obtain Vyral's Signet Ring.

records.name: True Believers
records.objectives_text: Hermit Ortell wants you to bring him 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts.

records.name: Reclaiming Sunstrider Isle
records.objectives_text: Kill 6 Mana Wyrms; they are located close to the Burning Crystals that are adjacent to the tower and gazebo. Return to Magistrix Erona at the tower on Sunstrider Isle when you are done.

records.name: Unfortunate Measures
records.objectives_text: Collect 8 Lynx Collars from slain Springpaw Lynxes and Springpaw Cubs. Return to Magistrix Erona on Sunstrider Isle when you are done.

records.name: Report to Lanthan Perilon
records.objectives_text: Speak with Lanthan Perilon on Sunstrider Isle; he is standing close to the path running west away from the Sunspire.

records.name: Mage Training
records.objectives_text: Speak with Julia Sunstriker - the Mage class trainer - inside the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.

records.name: Warrior Training
records.objectives_text: Speak with Delios - the Warrior class trainer - inside the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.

records.name: Solanian's Belongings
records.objectives_text: Collect Well Watcher Solanian's Scrying Orb, his Scroll of Scourge Magic, and his Journal. They are found on Sunstrider Isle by the pond, the fountain, and one of the Burning Crystals. Return them to the Well Watcher at the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle when you've collected them all.

records.name: Aggression
records.objectives_text: Kill 7 Tenders and 7 Feral Tenders, and then return to Lanthan Perilon on Sunstrider Isle.

records.name: Felendren the Banished
records.objectives_text: Kill 8 Arcane Wraiths and 2 Tainted Arcane Wraiths, as well as Felendren the Banished; they are located in the Falthrien Academy. Bring Felendren's Head to Lanthan Perilon on Sunstrider Isle.

records.name: A Fistful of Slivers
records.objectives_text: Collect 6 Arcane Slivers from any creature on the isle that uses mana, and then return to Arcanist Ithanas on Sunstrider Isle.

records.name: Tainted Arcane Sliver
records.objectives_text: Bring the Tainted Arcane Sliver to Arcanist Helion at the gazebo of the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.

records.name: The Shrine of Dath'Remar
records.objectives_text: Read the plaque on the Shrine of Dath'Remar and then return to Well Watcher Solanian at the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.

records.name: Thirst Unending
records.objectives_text: Use your Arcane Torrent racial ability on a Mana Wyrm, then return to Arcanist Helion.

records.name: Aiding the Outrunners
records.objectives_text: Speak with Outrunner Alarion near the bridge leading south of Sunstrider Isle.

records.name: Completing the Delivery
records.objectives_text: Deliver Erona's Package to Innkeeper Delaniel inside the inn at Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods.

records.name: Mastering the Elements
records.objectives_text: Bring the elements earth, air, fire and water to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.

records.name: Unstable Mana Crystals
records.objectives_text: Bring back 6 Unstable Mana Crystals to Aeldon Sunbrand at Falconwing Square.

records.name: WANTED: Thaelis the Hungerer
records.objectives_text: Bring Thaelis's Head to Sergeant Kan'ren at Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods.

records.name: Deadwood Ritual Totem
records.objectives_text: Take the Deadwood Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.

records.name: Major Malfunction
records.objectives_text: Collect 6 Arcane Core from the Arcane Patrollers that roam the ruins of Silvermoon City and bring them to Magister Jaronis at Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods.

records.name: A Somber Task
records.objectives_text: Slay 10 Withered Green Keepers at the Scorched Grove. Then report back to Larianna Riverwind inside the tower just to the northwest of the Scorched Grove in Eversong Woods.

records.name: Old Whitebark's Pendant
records.objectives_text: Find the person who might have made Old Withebark's Pendant. They might provide some insight on the item.

records.name: The Dead Scar
records.objectives_text: Slay 8 Plaguebone Pillagers and report back to Ranger Jaela on the Dead Scar in Eversong Woods.

records.name: Amani Encroachment
records.objectives_text: Lieutenant Dawnrunner at the Farstrider Retreat in Eversong Woods wants you to kill 5 Amani Berserkers and 5 Amani Axe Throwers.

records.name: The Spearcrafter's Hammer
records.objectives_text: Search Tor'Watha to the southeast of the Farstrider Retreat for Spearcrafter Otembe and bring Otembe's Hammer to Arathel Sunforge at the Farstrider Retreat in Eversong Woods.

records.name: Zul'Marosh
records.objectives_text: Ven'jashi, the troll prisoner at Tor'Watha, wants you to bring him Chieftain Zul'Marosh's Head. Chieftain Zul'Marosh can be found in Zeb'Watha, across Lake Elrendar.

records.name: Lost Armaments
records.objectives_text: Bring 8 Sin'dorei Armaments to Velendris Whitemorn in Eversong Woods.

records.name: The Root of All Evil
records.objectives_text: Plant the Demon Summoning Torch in the mouth of Grolnar's cave in the Winterfall furbolg village. Defeat the demon and retrieve the Essence of Xandivious for Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold.

records.name: Incriminating Documents
records.objectives_text: Bring the Incriminating Documents to Aeldon Sunbrand at Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods.

records.name: The Dwarven Spy
records.objectives_text: Bring Prospector Anvilward's Head to Aeldon Sunbrand at Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods.

records.name: Arcane Instability
records.objectives_text: Ley-Keeper Velania wants you to kill 5 Manawraiths and 5 Mana Stalkers.

records.name: Corrupted Soil
records.objectives_text: Apprentice Mirveda at the East Sanctum in Eversong Woods wants you to collect 8 Tainted Soil Samples.

records.name: Unexpected Results
records.objectives_text: Speak with Apprentice Mirveda and then protect her from the Scourge ambush.

records.name: Powering our Defenses
records.objectives_text: Place the Infused Crystal at the Eastern Runestone and protect it from the Scourge for 1 minute. Return the Infused Crystal to Runewarden Deryan in Eversong Woods for a reward.

records.name: Pelt Collection
records.objectives_text: Velan Brightoak at Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods wants you to bring him 6 Springpaw Pelts.

records.name: The Alliance Needs Copper Bars!
records.objectives_text: Bring 20 Copper Bars to Sergeant Stonebrow at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

records.objectives_text: Bring 20 Iron Bars to Corporal Carnes at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

records.objectives_text: Bring 20 Peacebloom to Herbalist Proudfeather at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

records.name: Signet of Unyielding Strength
records.objectives_text: Bring 1 Qiraji Magisterial Ring, 2 Lambent Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.

records.name: Drape of Unyielding Strength
records.objectives_text: Bring 1 Qiraji Martial Drape, 2 Onyx Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.

records.name: Sickle of Unyielding Strength
records.objectives_text: Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Alabaster Idols, 5 Crystal Scarabs and 5 Stone Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.

records.name: Priest Training
records.objectives_text: Speak with Matron Arena - the Priest class trainer - inside the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.

records.name: Mortal Champions
records.objectives_text: We sense the presence of our enslaved brethren deeper inside Ahn'Qiraj; yet not even an army of dragons would be enough to rescue them, . The same spell that imprisoned them would place us firmly under C'Thun's control should we come any closer to him. The Old God has foreseen our arrival. All hope is lost. What difference could a mere mortal like you possibly make?

records.name: The Horde Needs Firebloom!
records.objectives_text: Bring 20 Firebloom to Batrider Pele'keiki at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

records.objectives_text: Bring 20 Purple Lotus to Apothecary Jezel at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

records.objectives_text: You honor my kind, . Strike down the enemies of Kalimdor! Show them what it means to deface the land of eternal starlight. You have earned another enhancement. Hand me your signet ring so that I may bolster its power.

objectives.text: Return to Valadar Starsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

records.name: The Lunar Festival
records.objectives_text: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.

records.name: The Lunar Festival
records.objectives_text: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in Stormwind City.

records.name: The Lunar Festival
records.objectives_text: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.

records.name: The Lunar Festival
records.objectives_text: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.

records.name: The Lunar Festival
records.objectives_text: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the entrance to the Undercity. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.

records.name: The Lunar Festival
records.objectives_text: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger at the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.

records.name: Valadar Starsong
records.objectives_text: Use your Lunar Festival Invitation in the moonlight to travel to Moonglade. Speak with Valadar Starsong in Nighthaven when you arrive.

records.name: Fish Heads, Fish Heads...
records.objectives_text: Collect 8 Grimscale Murloc Heads. Return them to Hathvelion Sungaze in the Eversong Woods on the bluff overlooking the Tranquil Shore.

records.name: The Ring of Mmmrrrggglll
records.objectives_text: Retrieve the Ring of Mmmrrrggglll from the Grimscale chieftain's dead clutches. Return it to Hathvelion Sungaze in the Eversong Woods on the bluff overlooking the Tranquil Shore.

records.name: Grimscale Pirates!
records.objectives_text: Retrieve 6 of Captain Kelisendra's Cargo and return them to Captain Kelisendra at the defended camp just to the east of the Sunsail Anchorage in Eversong Woods.

records.name: Captain Kelisendra's Lost Rutters
records.objectives_text: Return Captain Kelisendra's Lost Rutters to Captain Kelisendra at the defended camp just to the east of the Sunsail Anchorage in Eversong Woods.

records.name: The Magister's Apprentice
records.objectives_text: Speak with Apprentice Loralthalis near Duskwither Spire in Eversong Woods.

records.name: Deactivating the Spire
records.objectives_text: Deactivate the 3 Duskwither Spire Power Sources inside Duskwither Spire. Then return the Deactivating Jewel to Apprentice Loralthalis in Eversong Woods.

records.name: Word from the Spire
records.objectives_text: Return to Magister Duskwither at the Farstrider Retreat in Eversong Woods.

records.name: Abandoned Investigations
records.objectives_text: Return Magister Duskwither's Journal to Magister Duskwither at the Farstrider Retreat in Eversong Woods.

records.name: Situation at Sunsail Anchorage
records.objectives_text: Kill 5 Wretched Thugs and 5 Wretched Hooligans and report back to Ranger Degolien in Eversong Woods.

records.name: Cleaning up the Grounds
records.objectives_text: Kill 6 Mana Serpents and 6 Ether Fiends and return to Groundskeeper Wyllithen at Duskwither Grounds in Eversong Woods.

records.name: Delivery to the North Sanctum
records.objectives_text: Deliver the Unmarked Letter to Ley-Keeper Caidanis at the North Sanctum in Eversong Woods.
